content_zh:
“我说你有什么想知道的尽管问,别老是盯着我不放。就算你不饿,我这刚才打了半天架,也该点补点东西了。”苏沐打破这种很为尴尬的氛围,微笑着说道。
李乐天猛地一拍桌子,大声道:“我说你刚才说的是真的?这块玺印是真货?要是买的话别说几百,就是几千都拿不下来?”
“不相信我你干嘛要买。”苏沐扬眉道。
“哈哈,这下我真的赚到了,几百块钱买到个真货,这要是拿回去送给爷爷,相信他绝对会喜欢的。”李乐天激动道。
“放心吧,保证是真货!不过这玺印应该一对,算了,有时间的话我再给你找找。”苏沐随意道。
“够兄弟!”李乐天大笑道:“没想到我李乐天来一趟邢唐县,还能够遇到你这样对脾气的兄弟,来,啥也别说了,这顿我请,咱们不醉不归!”
“我下午还有活动,陪你喝点就是。”
“真是没劲!”
苏沐无所谓的一笑,李乐天倒是没有坚持,两人就这样有一杯没一杯的喝酒聊着天。吃完后,李乐天便起身道:“兄弟,我是真的有事,必须马上离开回京城。这是我的手机号,还有这个手机号你也记下,那个蠢货真要找你麻烦,就打这个号,保证收拾的他服服帖帖的!我过几天再来,咱们非得喝个痛快!”
“好说!”苏沐笑着记下来。
“走了!”
邢唐县教育局小礼堂。
这样的会议历来县委书记都不会前来参加,因为没有那个必要。以前召开的几次,除了最开始主管教育文化工作的副县长来过一次外,会议便一直由教育局局长高萍主持。而面对着邢唐县十几个乡镇的副镇长们,高萍总能找到些优越感。
苏沐提前来到小礼堂,随便找了个座位坐下,这样的会议他虽然是第一次以副镇长的身份参加,但却并不陌生,对高萍这个女人他都很熟悉。在政府办待着的半年,苏沐像是这种工作都做的很到位。
“苏镇长,你怎么现在才来?”
就在苏沐刚坐下没多久,旁边便坐过来一个中年男子,穿着灰色的半袖,满脸笑容递过来一根香烟。
“周镇长,这怎么好意思!”苏沐连忙接过烟,随后便掏出打火机给男子点着,两人开始吞云吐雾起来。
这么多副镇长中,苏沐就和眼前这位比较熟悉,周正,龙井镇副镇长。和他熟悉,是因为苏沐老家就是龙井镇的。经过人介绍后,两人便有过几次联系。一来二往后,便算是有些交情。
周正这人比较爽朗,他不会因为苏沐年纪小就看不上他,他和人交往完全看的是对不对脾气。性情相投,你说什么都行。真要是遇到看不顺眼的,多说一句话他都觉得是对他的侮辱。
以前苏沐就知道周正和自己关系不错,但却不敢怎么肯定,刚才在两人碰触的瞬间,他便有意求证了下,这一求证果真证明他的猜测。

亲密度:六十!
这样的亲密度,在苏沐所接触过的人中,绝对属于最高的。你对我真心,我便不会对你虚以委蛇。向来重感情的苏沐,便开始和周正聊上。
“苏沐啊,这会议第一次参加吧?”周正笑着问道。
“是啊,第一次,你也知道我刚到黑山镇不到半年,这会议怎么能够参加好几次。不过在县政府办的时候,倒是来帮过两次忙,也不算陌生。”苏沐淡淡道。
“是吧,我就说你怎么看上去一点都不紧张那。”
“紧张什么?难道我紧张,咱们的高局长就会放过我吗?”
“别怕,黑山镇的情况摆在那里,怨不得你。”
“我不是怕,就是为黑山镇那十个村的孩子着急,你老哥也知道,要是再不想办法改善那里的教育情况,恐怕会出大问题的。”
......
两人就这么有一句没一句的聊了会,突然周正双眼眯缝着问道:“苏沐,别怪老哥没有提醒你,你难道没有觉得进来后这里的气氛有些不对劲吗?”
不对劲?被周正这么一提醒,苏沐扫向四周,瞧见那些个副镇长的神情,坐着的位置,才感到真的是有些不对劲。
最开始苏沐还以为这些人是因为自己年轻,想要摆老资格,故意不搭理自己。但现在听周正的话,完全就不是那回事。每个人脸上的神情,除了不屑之外,竟然还夹带了些许幸灾乐祸。

content_en:
"I said if you have anything you want to know, just ask. Don't stare at me all the time. Even if you're not hungry, I've just been fighting for a long time, so it's time to get something to eat." Su Mu broke the awkward atmosphere and said with a smile.
Li Letian slammed the table and said loudly: "Is what you just said true? Is this seal genuine? If you buy it, let alone hundreds, even thousands, you can't get it?"
"Why do you want to buy it if you don't believe me?" Su Mu raised her eyebrows.
"Haha, I really made a profit now. I bought a real product for a few hundred yuan. If I take this back and give it to my grandpa, I believe he will definitely like it." Li Letian said excitedly.
"Don't worry, it's guaranteed to be genuine! But there should be a pair of these seals. Forget it, I'll look for them for you if I have time." Su Mu said casually.
"That's enough brother!" Li Letian laughed and said, "I didn't expect that I, Li Letian, would come to Xingtang County and meet a brother with such a bad temper like you. Come on, don't say anything. I'll treat you to this meal. We won't come back until we get drunk!"
"I have activities in the afternoon, so I'll just have a drink with you."
"It's so boring!"
Su Mu smiled indifferently, but Li Letian didn't insist. The two of them just drank and chatted. After eating, Li Letian stood up and said: "Brother, I really have something to do and I must leave back to the capital immediately. This is my mobile phone number. You should also write down this mobile phone number. If that idiot really wants to trouble you, just call this number. I guarantee that he will deal with it obediently! I will come back in a few days, and we must have a good drink!"
"Easy to say!" Su Mu smiled and wrote it down.
"Let's go!"
Xingtang County Education Bureau Small Auditorium.
The county party committee secretaries have never come to attend such meetings because there is no need. In the previous meetings, except for the first visit by the deputy county magistrate who was in charge of education and cultural work, the meeting has always been chaired by Gao Ping, director of the Education Bureau. Facing the deputy mayors of more than a dozen towns in Xingtang County, Gao Ping can always find some sense of superiority.
Su Mu came to the small auditorium in advance and found a seat to sit down. Although it was his first time to attend such a meeting as the deputy mayor, he was not unfamiliar with it. He was very familiar with the woman Gao Ping. During the half year of working in the government office, Su Muxiang did this kind of work very well.
"Mayor Su, why did you come just now?"
Not long after Su Mu sat down, a middle-aged man sat next to him, wearing gray half-sleeves, with a smile on his face and handed over a cigarette.
"Mayor Zhou, how can you be so embarrassed!" Su Mu quickly took the cigarette, then took out a lighter and lit it for the man, and the two began to puff away the smoke.
Among so many deputy mayors, Su Mu is more familiar with the one in front of him, Zhou Zheng, deputy mayor of Longjing Town. We are familiar with him because Su Mu's hometown is Longjing Town. After being introduced, the two had several contacts. After going back and forth, we can be considered to have some friendship.
Zhou Zheng is a more cheerful person. He will not look down on Su Mu just because he is young. His interactions with people all depend on his temperament. If you have the same temperament, you can say whatever you want. If he really meets someone he doesn't like, any more words he says will be considered an insult to him.
Su Mu had known that Zhou Zheng had a good relationship with him before, but he was not sure. The moment the two of them touched, he deliberately verified it, and this verification really proved his guess.
Intimacy: sixty!
This kind of intimacy is definitely the highest among the people Su Mu has come into contact with. If you are sincere to me, I will not treat you in vain. Su Mu, who has always valued emotions, started chatting with Zhou Zheng.
"Su Mu, is this your first time attending this meeting?" Zhou Zheng asked with a smile.
"Yes, it's the first time. You know how I have been able to attend this meeting several times since I arrived in Heishan Town less than half a year ago. But when I was running the county government, I came to help twice, so it's not a stranger." Su Mu said lightly.
"Yeah, I'll tell you what you thinkI wasn't nervous at all when I went up there. "
"Why are you nervous? Could it be that if I'm nervous, will our Director Gao let me go?"
"Don't be afraid, the situation in Black Mountain Town is there, I can't blame you. "
"I'm either afraid or worried about the children in the ten villages in Heishan Town. Your brother also knows that if we don't think of ways to improve the education situation there, there may be big problems. "
...
The two chatted without saying a word for a while. Suddenly Zhou Zheng asked with squinted eyes: "Su Mu, don't blame me for not reminding you. Didn't you feel that something was wrong with the atmosphere here after you came in?"
Something is wrong? After being reminded by Zhou Zheng, Su Mu glanced around and saw the expressions and sitting positions of the deputy mayors, and felt that something was really wrong.
At first, Su Mu thought these people were deliberately ignoring her because they were young and wanted to show off their seniority. But now listening to Zhou Zheng's words, it's not that at all. The expression on everyone's face, in addition to disdain, was also mixed with a little schadenfreude.
